factors.name: nvda_range_vs_aapl_range_lag1
factors.hypothesis: Yesterday's relative NVDA/AAPL range captures persistence in tech risk appetite that isn't covered by today's spread.

factors.name: nvda_range_vs_msft_range
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low), NVDA_Close), safe_divide(subtract(MSFT_High, MSFT_Low), MSFT_Close))
factors.hypothesis: NVDA's excess range over another mega-cap measures semis-specific stress independent of AAPL's own range.

factors.name: nvda_range_ratio_aapl
factors.hypothesis: The log ratio of ranges is a scale-free version of the kept spread, more stable across volatility regimes.

factors.name: aapl_gap_vs_qqq_gap
factors.hypothesis: AAPL-specific overnight gap relative to the market indicates idiosyncratic news that may mean-revert or continue.

factors.name: qqq_close_position_in_range
factors.hypothesis: Where the market closes in its daily range reflects late-day buying/selling pressure which carries to the next day.

factors.name: aapl_volume_change_x_nvda_range
factors.formula: multiply(pct_change(AAPL_Volume, 1), subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low), NVDA_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close)))
factors.hypothesis: Interaction of AAPL volume change with relative NVDA turbulence picks out regimes of rotation in or out of AAPL.
